resources.string: For your requests, Mochi reads filtered controls in apps you select and lets your model choose actions. Related interface text may be sent to your model Provider and conversation history. Music apps are selected by default. Login, payments and other sensitive operations require your intervention. You can remove apps or disable this access at any time.
Open Mochi to answer or manage the website login
Say %1$s or use a headset button
Tap to start the voice conversation
